description: Run a Logs Insights query against CloudWatch Logs and materialize the result as a DataFrame.

outputs.description: Log/metric rows returned by the Logs Insights query

log_group_names.label: Log Group Names
log_group_names.description: One or more log group names to query

query_string.label: Query String
query_string.description: Logs Insights query (e.g. 'fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/ | limit 100')

range_minutes.label: Range Minutes
range_minutes.description: How far back from now to query, in minutes

aws_access_key_id_env_var.label: AWS Access Key ID Env Var
aws_access_key_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the AWS access key ID. Leave unset to use the default AWS credential chain.

aws_secret_access_key_env_var.label: AWS Secret Access Key Env Var
aws_secret_access_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the AWS secret access key. Leave unset to use the default AWS credential chain.

max_wait_seconds.label: Max Wait Seconds
max_wait_seconds.description: Max wait for the query to complete

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily'/'weekly'/'monthly'/'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'dynamic' for values added at runtime. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.
